name: Utilify
description: 63+ free, private, offline-first client-side web utilities for developers, creators, and professionals. All data formatting, image processing, and PDF manipulations execute 100% in local browser memory.

resources.name: Merge PDF
resources.description: Combine multiple PDF files client-side into a single document without server uploads.

resources.name: Compress PDF
resources.description: Compress PDF documents in local browser memory with visual quality preservation.

resources.name: Image to PDF
resources.description: Convert JPG, PNG, and WebP images to a single PDF document client-side.

resources.name: PDF to Image
resources.description: Extract and render all pages of a PDF document into JPG or PNG image files.

resources.name: Split PDF
resources.description: Extract custom page ranges or separate individual PDF pages client-side.

resources.name: Image Compressor
resources.description: Optimize and compress JPEG, PNG, and WebP images client-side directly in browser memory.

resources.name: JSON Prettifier & Validator
resources.description: Prettify, format, validate, and minify JSON data structures client-side.
